01 / YOUR PREFERENCE

What feels right today?

Porridge keeps cooking and blending separate, so soft grains don’t have to become a smooth paste.

What changes behind this choice?

Consistency changes the ingredient ratio. Texture changes blending. Neither setting measures swallowing safety. Amounts and timings are illustrative prototype values.

My saved preferences (0)

Stored only in this browser. Loading a preference restores the recipe, not ingredients or a running cycle.

02 / GUIDED WEIGHING

First, add rice.

0g / 40 g

How does the scale know?

It measures mass, not ingredient identity. Rice and water are added in separate steps. Confirming rice stores its weight and tares the scale so only newly added water is measured. This demo assumes the intended ingredient was added.

DESIGNED AROUND PEOPLE

Guidance when you need it.
Detail when you want it.

This is an educational redesign, not a validated cooking appliance. Ingredient ratios, stages, temperatures, and completion estimates are simulated. Saved preferences record your choices and feedback; they do not certify a result as safe for swallowing. For someone with swallowing difficulties, preparation should follow their clinician’s guidance.
